name: SEO Search Analytics Benchmarks
description: Open reference dataset of Google Search Console / organic-search benchmarks: expected click-through rate by ranking position, position bands, and indexing-health thresholds. Maintained alongside gsc-cli.
attribution: Data by SEO Consult (https://seoconsult.bg), CC BY 4.0. Attribution required.

ctr_by_position.note: Expected organic CTR for web results. Values materially below the band for a position indicate a title/meta opportunity.

position_bands.label: first_page
position_bands.action: Improve CTR vs. band (title/meta) to lift clicks.

position_bands.label: striking_distance
position_bands.action: Prime quick-win zone: small gains push to page 1.

quick_wins.striking_distance: Queries at position 11-20 with high impressions.
quick_wins.low_ctr_page_one: Queries at position 4-10 with CTR below the expected band.

cannibalization.rule: One query served by >= 2 URLs, each with meaningful impressions, that split authority and CTR.

indexing_health.note: A 'not indexed' coverage state on a top page is a priority issue.

caveats.note: GSC data is delayed ~2-3 days; always state the analysis window.
